product_one_liner.value: nudge gives employers a personalized financial-wellbeing platform that helps employees make better financial and benefits decisions through impartial financial education and guidance.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes personalized financial education for employees as the core of employer financial-wellbeing programs.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link; the FAQ says pricing is customized and directs prospective customers to contact nudge for commercial options.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in nudge client stories.

hq_location.notes: The contact page labels its London address as the Global HQ.

founded_year.notes: The company says its founders’ idea became nudge in 2013.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows workplace financial-wellbeing insights, reports, awards/news and client stories, not posts about how the product is built by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The site links to a single FAQ page but does not list a product documentation, help-center or developer portal in its navigation/footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists Strategic Account Executive and Senior Software Engineer; neither is an AI, ML or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The AI page and FAQ identify numa as nudge’s AI but do not name an underlying model or provider; the Trust Center subprocessor listing was also checked and does not publicly identify one.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names GDPR and ISO/IEC 27001 in its compliance list; other listed standards are outside the requested set.

last_funding.notes: Nudge’s March 2021 company announcement identifies Kennet Partners’ growth-equity investment; the company LinkedIn page’s linked funding record reports a $7 million Series A. Funding databases differ slightly on the month and round label.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified outside investment was the Kennet growth-equity/Series A round in March 2021, well before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists a Strategic Account Executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Nudge announced personalized financial action plans on September 1, 2026, within the six-month window before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Nudge announced the appointment of Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as U.S. Vice Presidents on October 15, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy identifies a HubSpot marketing pixel and describes HubSpot as the marketing platform.
